artifact.astrolabe_isfahan.name: Brass Astrolabe of Isfahan
artifact.astrolabe_isfahan.desc: A 12th-century brass astrolabe engraved with Arabic star names, used by astronomers at the Isfahan observatory to chart the heavens.
artifact.quran_manuscript_cairo.name: Illuminated Quran of Sultan Baybars
artifact.quran_manuscript_cairo.desc: A 13th-century Quran commissioned by Sultan Baybars, with gold-leaf illumination and intricate geometric borders painted by master calligraphers in Cairo.
artifact.iznik_tile_istanbul.name: Iznik Ceramic Tile Panel
artifact.iznik_tile_istanbul.desc: A 16th-century panel of cobalt-blue and tulip-red Iznik tiles, originally part of the interior decoration of the Rüstem Pasha Mosque in Istanbul.
artifact.khanjar_muscat.name: Silver Khanjar of the Sultan
artifact.khanjar_muscat.desc: A ceremonial curved dagger with a silver-filigree sheath and rhinoceros-horn hilt, presented to the Sultan of Oman in the 18th century.
artifact.brass_lamp_cairo.name: Mamluk Mosque Lamp
artifact.brass_lamp_cairo.desc: A pierced brass hanging lamp from the Mamluk era, inscribed with the Verse of Light in flowing thuluth script, once suspended in a Cairo madrasa.
artifact.whirling_robe_konya.name: Dervish Ceremonial Robe
artifact.whirling_robe_konya.desc: A white wool tennure robe worn by a senior Mevlevi dervish during the sema ceremony at the Konya lodge, dating to the 17th century.
artifact.samarkand_paper_tashkent.name: Samarkand Silk Paper Folio
artifact.samarkand_paper_tashkent.desc: A folio of polished mulberry-bark paper from the legendary Samarkand mills, bearing a treatise on algebra in the hand of a 10th-century scholar.
artifact.mughal_miniature_lahore.name: Mughal Miniature Painting
artifact.mughal_miniature_lahore.desc: A jewel-toned miniature depicting Emperor Jahangir receiving a Sufi saint, painted with crushed lapis lazuli and gold at the Lahore court.
artifact.zellige_mosaic_fez.name: Zellige Mosaic Star Panel
artifact.zellige_mosaic_fez.desc: A hand-cut geometric mosaic of glazed terracotta tiles arranged in a 16-point star, removed from a 14th-century riad courtyard in the Fez medina.
artifact.dead_sea_scrolls_amman.name: Copper Scroll of the Dead Sea
artifact.dead_sea_scrolls_amman.desc: A thin copper sheet inscribed with an inventory of hidden treasures, discovered in a cave near the Dead Sea and kept in the Amman Citadel museum.
artifact.pearl_chest_dubai.name: Pearl Diver's Chest
artifact.pearl_chest_dubai.desc: A teak chest inlaid with mother-of-pearl, used by Gulf pearl merchants to store and grade natural pearls before the oil era transformed Dubai.
artifact.vakufnama_sarajevo.name: Ottoman Vakufnama of Gazi Husrev-beg
artifact.vakufnama_sarajevo.desc: A 1531 endowment deed in ornate Ottoman calligraphy, establishing Sarajevo's great mosque, library, and madrasa -- the founding charter of the city's Islamic cultural quarter.
artifact.zanzibar_door.name: Carved Door of Stone Town
artifact.zanzibar_door.desc: A massive teak door studded with brass spikes and carved with lotus and chain motifs, once the entrance to a wealthy Omani merchant's house in Zanzibar.
artifact.muslin_dhaka.name: Jamdani Muslin Sari
artifact.muslin_dhaka.desc: A near-translucent handwoven muslin sari with supplementary weft patterns, produced by Dhaka weavers whose technique was once thought lost to history.
artifact.pewter_tankard_kuala_lumpur.des: A ceremonial pewter wine vessel crafted from Straits tin, decorated with Islamic arabesques and presented to a Malay sultan in the 19th century.
artifact.keris_jakarta.name: Javanese Keris Blade
artifact.keris_jakarta.desc: A sinuous-bladed keris with a damascened iron blade folded from meteorite nickel, believed to hold spiritual power and forged by an empu master smith.
artifact.cedar_oud_beirut.name: Cedar-Wood Oud
artifact.cedar_oud_beirut.desc: A pear-shaped oud crafted from Lebanese cedar with bone tuning pegs, once played by a renowned musician at the Beirut conservatory.
artifact.glass_weight_dakar.name: Fatimid Glass Weight
artifact.glass_weight_dakar.desc: A translucent green glass disc stamped with a Fatimid caliph's name, used as a trade standard along the trans-Saharan gold route through Dakar.
